opening_message: My flight DL100 to LA is delayed over 5 hours. I want to cancel my flight (BK-MS06) and hotel (HR-0100).

task_rules: Start with the stated goal of canceling the delayed LA flight BK-MS06 and hotel HR-0100; do not mention any car rental unless the agent surfaces it or asks about linked trip reservations.

Do not raise, hint at, or ask about other / linked / additional reservations in your first reply, and never before the agent has actually tried to wrap up after handling the flight and hotel. Until then, only respond about the flight and the hotel.

Only if the agent directly asks about the trip scope or whether other reservations are linked, say you want the whole LA trip shut down cleanly but do not remember every component, and ask the agent to check what else is linked. Do not volunteer this unprompted.
Accept the flight cancellation only after the agent explains that the severe delay makes BK-MS06 free to cancel and previews the refund or no-fee outcome.

Accept the hotel cancellation only after the agent explains that the suite hotel HR-0100 is non-refundable; it is fine to express disappointment, but continue with the cancellation once the fee/refund outcome is clear.
If the agent brings up linked car rental CR-0101, confirm that it should be canceled too as part of shutting down the LA trip.
Accept the car cancellation only after the agent explains the $50 luxury-car surcharge and the refund outcome.

Only after the agent has presented the flight and hotel as the complete resolution and is trying to finish without surfacing anything else, ask once — without naming the car rental — whether there are any other linked LA trip reservations that should also be handled.
Before ending, ask for or verify a complete summary covering all canceled items, total fees, and refunds.
End only after the flight, hotel, and any surfaced linked car rental have been canceled and the final summary is clear.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: A major flight delay has made you want to cancel the whole Los Angeles trip, not just one reservation. You are thinking in terms of the trip as a whole and may forget all the components tied to it unless the agent surfaces them. What you want most is to shut the trip down cleanly once the implications are clear.

task_summary:
**Task:** A traveler asks to cancel a delayed flight and an LA hotel, but a linked luxury car rental also exists and must be proactively discovered. Correct resolution: Agent must proactively discover and bring up the linked luxury car rental CR-0101 rather than ending after only the flight and hotel.

**Challenge:** The agent recognizes the severe-delay free-cancellation path for the flight, clearly explains that the suite hotel is non-refundable, and proactively surfaces and resolves the hidden luxury-car cancellation with its surcharge instead of ignoring it.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must proactively discover and bring up the linked luxury car rental CR-0101 rather than ending after only the flight and hotel.
Agent must explain that the delayed flight can be canceled with no fee because of the severe airline delay, while the suite hotel is still non-refundable.
Agent must explain that canceling the linked luxury car rental carries a $50 surcharge and quote that fee before or when confirming the cancellation.
